nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

buyingFormat.description: Purchase format. Optional values: `Auction` (auction), `BIN` (fixed price), `BO` (best offer)

categoryId.description: eBay category ID, used to search for specified categories

ebayDomain.description: eBay site domain name. Optional values: `ebay.com` (United States), `ebay.co.uk` (UK), `ebay.de` (Germany), `ebay.fr` (France), `ebay.it` (Italy), `ebay.es` (Spain), `ebay.ca` (Canada), `ebay.com.au` (Australia) ), `ebay.nl` (Netherlands), `ebay.at` (Austria), `ebay.ch` (Switzerland), `ebay.pl` (Poland), `ebay.ie` (Ireland), `ebay.com.hk` (Hong Kong, China), `ebay.com.my` (Malaysia), `ebay.com.sg` (Singapore)

itemCondition.description: Product status code, multiple separated by `\|`. Optional values: `1000` (new), `1500` (new other), `1750` (new with defects), `2000` (official refurbished), `2010` (excellent refurbished), `2020` (Good Refurbished), `2030` (Generally Refurbished), `2500` (Seller Refurbished), `2750` (Almost New), `3000` (Second Hand/Used), `7000` (Accessory or Not Working)

location.description: The country/region code where the product is located, for example: `1` (United States), `2` (Canada), `3` (UK), `45` (China), `77` (Germany)

orderBy.description: Sort by. Optional values: `1` (soon to end), `2` (lowest price), `3` (highest price), `7` (closest), `10` (latest on the shelves), `12` (best match), `15` (lowest price + shipping fee), `16` (highest price + shipping fee), `18` (new product first), `19` (second-hand priority)

pageSize.description: The maximum number of results returned per page. Optional values: `25`, `50`, `100`, `200`

showOnly.description: Filter conditions, multiple values separated by commas. Optional values: `Complete` (Ended), `Sold` (Sold), `FR` (Free Returns), `RPA` (Returns Accepted), `AS` (Authorized Seller), `Savings` (discount), `SaleItems` (promotional items), `Lots` (bulk), `Charity` (charity), `AV`, `FS` (free shipping), `LPickup` (self-pickup)

zipCode.description: ZIP or postal code to filter products for delivery by area
